caption: The drawing depicts a central figure of a man crucified on a cross, with a green crown of thorns on his head, a cloth of blue with white spots covering his waist, and blood marks on various parts of his body including the head, arms, knees, side, and feet. The cross itself is green with the ends of the horizontal beam painted red, and a partial wooden plank extends upward from the top with a small skull placed on it. Additional illustrations appear on the left, right, and bottom: the left shows a view from the back with a red heart suspended in a cavity in the upper back, with ribs visible across the opening and a similar blue cloth; the right side features a profile drawing of the crucified figure's head displaying a forward-drooping posture, and beneath it, a detailed drawing of a human skull with two small pegs. Handwritten notes surround the images, describing anatomical details such as the way the neck skin is attached for head posture, suspension of the heart, and the features of the skull. The drawing uses mainly muted tones, primarily greens, blues, reds, and beiges. The author's name and location, "Majel C. Chaplin - Taos, N.M.," are written in the lower right.
title: Wooden Painted Christo
